segments.dialogue: Need a simple snack for the table? Meet Crown Almond Biscuits, ready to share.
segments.subject: Hands rapidly present Crown Almond Biscuits through plate, handful and retail-box views on one bright home tabletop.
segments.action: Build the opening as six brisk product shots: a flash of abundance, an open packet over a plate, a hand gathering biscuits, two changing handful views, then a direct overhead box-opening reveal.
segments.performance: Fast, slightly imperfect first-person snack-review gestures with believable grip pressure and no visible face.
segments.intention: Match the source's immediate abundance hook and its sharp switch into package proof while making the target product recognisable within the first second.

reference_frames.first_frame: First-person vertical snack-review frame on a bright tabletop: a shallow cream plate crowded with separate golden rectangular Crown almond biscuits fills the lower frame, one opened white Crown packet sits above it, and one natural hand reaches toward the biscuits.
reference_frames.camera: extreme product close-up | first-person high angle about 45 degrees | handheld micro-sway | plate, packet and reaching hand fill about eighty-five percent of frame
reference_frames.performance: One natural hand enters with active fingers and casual asymmetry, ready for quick unscripted gathering and presentation gestures.

reference_frames.first_frame: Directly overhead hands-only view of one complete Crown Almond Biscuits retail box centred on the same bright tabletop, with both hands resting naturally on the top flaps and white individual packets visible as the box begins to open.
reference_frames.camera: box close-up | first-person directly overhead about 90 degrees | locked smartphone with slight hand vibration | retail box centred and filling about seventy percent of frame
reference_frames.performance: Both hands begin a brisk practical opening movement with slightly uneven natural finger positions.

timed_shots.direction: show a near-instant close flash of two overlapping biscuit plates and a white packet
hold one opened white packet above the full plate and tilt it slightly toward the biscuits
one hand gathers several separate rectangular biscuits from the plate and lifts them
jump to two hands presenting four biscuits in a loose fan close to the lens
jump to one palm holding an overlapping handful and make one quick angle change
hard cut overhead as two hands open the retail box and reveal white packets

segments.dialogue: Open the box, pass the packets around, and set the biscuits in the middle.
segments.subject: White Crown packets, rectangular biscuits and the complete retail box cycle through five rapid hands-only proof shots.
segments.action: Move through packet spread, tear-open, packet-to-plate, biscuit handful and box-front evidence views with the exact source cut density.
segments.performance: Brisk practical hands make quick resets between hard cuts; every pose looks candid rather than staged.
segments.intention: Preserve the source progression from package opening to a clear brand-and-product identity check without unsupported quantity or ingredient claims.

reference_frames.first_frame: First-person high-angle close-up on the same bright table: both hands hold one white Crown individual packet at its sealed top seam above a shallow plate, with several matching packets scattered naturally behind.
reference_frames.camera: packaging close-up | first-person high angle about 45 degrees | handheld micro-follow | sealed packet centred above the plate with repeated packets behind
reference_frames.performance: Two hands use a believable foil grip with small wrinkles, natural finger pressure and a quick ready-to-tear posture.

reference_frames.first_frame: One hand holds the complete Crown Almond Biscuits retail box square and close to the camera while the other hand presents one whole golden rectangular biscuit beside the visible front artwork on the same bright tabletop.
reference_frames.camera: extreme packaging close-up | first-person slight high angle about 15 degrees | nearly locked handheld | box front and one biscuit occupy about eighty percent of frame
reference_frames.performance: The hands hold a calm factual comparison pose with relaxed fingers and the package front unobstructed.

timed_shots.direction: lift one packet from a loose spread of matching packets toward the lens

hard cut wider and tip the opened packet so one biscuit settles onto the plate
jump to one palm holding a generous overlapping stack of rectangular biscuits near the lens
hard cut to the complete box front while the other hand holds one matching biscuit beside it

segments.dialogue: Show the golden biscuits up close, then break one open and pair it with milk.
segments.subject: Rectangular Crown almond biscuits fill a sequence of edge, surface, plate and break-open macro views.
segments.action: Run seven tight tactile shots from stacked biscuit edges through surface and plate views into one clean centre break and a final two-halves macro.
segments.performance: Hands remain close to the lens with believable pressure, fast reframing and a relaxed release after the break.
segments.intention: Keep the source's dense visual proof rhythm while selling only visible shape, serving and break-open actions.

reference_frames.first_frame: Two hands hold two short stacks of golden rectangular Crown almond biscuits side by side near the lens, exposing the thin edges and baked surfaces, with a shallow plate of matching biscuits below.
reference_frames.camera: macro close-up | first-person high angle about 25 degrees | tiny focus settle | two biscuit stacks fill the central eighty percent
reference_frames.performance: Careful fingertips maintain natural pressure on two stable stacks and can quickly reset into surface and plate views.

reference_frames.first_frame: Two hands hold one complete intact rectangular Crown almond biscuit horizontally close to the lens, thumbs meeting near the centre and fingers supporting both ends, with the matching plate softly blurred below.
reference_frames.camera: extreme macro | first-person near eye level about 15 degrees above | handheld focus breathing | intact biscuit and fingertips fill the centre
reference_frames.performance: Thumbs show believable tension immediately before one decisive snap while the other fingers remain asymmetric and relaxed.

segments.dialogue: Share a few around, and give Crown Almond Biscuits a try.
segments.subject: A friendly sharing gesture cuts to one biscuit meeting milk and a spoon lifting the milk-paired result.
segments.action: Finish with three clear actions in source order: pass one biscuit from a handful, lower one whole biscuit into a single milk bowl, then lift the result on one spoon.
segments.performance: Friendly hands-only close with quick decisive actions and a steady final spoon lift.
segments.intention: Preserve the source's practical milk-pairing ending and leave a short clean hold for the English call to action.

reference_frames.first_frame: One palm holds several golden rectangular Crown almond biscuits above the full sharing plate while a second open hand enters from the side ready to take one, with white target packets behind.
reference_frames.camera: product close-up | first-person high angle about 45 degrees | handheld follows the taking hand | biscuit palm centred over the plate
reference_frames.performance: Two natural hands form different friendly poses, one steady and one reaching for a single biscuit.

reference_frames.first_frame: High-angle close-up of one shallow white bowl of plain milk on the same tabletop: one metal spoon rests in the bowl and supports one whole rectangular Crown almond biscuit near the milk surface, with the target box and packet visible behind.
reference_frames.camera: extreme food close-up | first-person high angle about 50 degrees | handheld prepared to follow the spoon | spoon and rectangular biscuit centred over one milk bowl
reference_frames.performance: One steady off-frame hand controls the spoon with a careful natural lift while the bowl remains still.
